lines.text: Joram sent two horsemen to ask Jehu who their commander was, and neither returned, so Joram rode out himself.

wrong_details.true: ask whether they came in peace

lines.text: Ahaziah was shot near Ibleam, fled to Samaria and died, and his servants carried him to Jerusalem.
Eunuchs threw Jezebel down at Jehu's command, and Jehu said the word of the LORD through Elijah was fulfilled.
